title: RAII Owner
prompt: Implement class `IntBox`: constructor `explicit IntBox(int value)` stores a heap `int` (using new — the one sanctioned place), `get() const` returns the value, destructor frees it. Deleting copy construction/assignment is required. Then implement `make_doubled(int)` returning `std::unique_ptr<IntBox>` holding the doubled value.

tests.name: no copy
tests.hint: Copy construction must be deleted — one owner.
